integrity: Standalone proof and executable finite diagnostics; auxiliary finite tests are not proofs of universally quantified claims.
scientific_limitations: Scalar Schur symbols vanishing at zero, a single critical three-site weighted shift (up to edge reversal); qualitative monomial extremality and the exact supremum are prior results; only quantitative two-well stability and the explicit mixing bound are asserted as new. Potential coverage by unindexed general symbol-stability theory remains. No independent mathematical validation.
title: Sharp asymmetric Hardy stability at coexisting linear and quadratic nilpotent extremizers
